what_it_does: This is a specialized processor for convolutional neural networks (CNNs) targeting small-object detection in high-resolution 2-megapixel videos. The chip uses bidirectional feature pyramid networks (FPNs)—a technique that processes features at multiple scales to detect small objects. It optimizes memory bandwidth by reordering how data flows (orientation-interleaved causally-processed modeling) and decides whether to reuse data from memory or recompute it. The reconfigurable tensor engine adapts to different network operations.
